title: App icons / Design

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Distinguish products without fragmenting the parent identity, because people need to recognize both the app and its family.
strategic_value: Three coordinated icon styles can accommodate IBM product differences while retaining common geometry and color behavior.
demonstration: The guide compares stroke, fill and Plex app icons, decomposes their layers and supplies correct-versus-incorrect construction examples.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate app-icon style and assemble its required components rather than borrowing a product symbol as a general metaphor.

content_islands.name: Three style families
content_islands.spec: Introduce stroke, fill and Plex examples beneath the resources.

content_islands.name: Stroke components
content_islands.spec: Show the stationary color gradient, gradient mask and solid-stroke layer with labeled examples and prohibitions.

content_islands.name: Fill components
content_islands.spec: Explain the primary gradient, secondary accent and tertiary gradient with geometric masks and comparisons.

content_islands.name: Plex components
content_islands.spec: Finish with solid letterforms, character-count limits, baseline alignment and whole-icon color examples.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction says app icons identify products at a glance while expressing the IBM brand.
reference_purposes.Expression: Stroke, filled and typographic icons share geometry and luminous gradients.
reference_purposes.Application: Layer diagrams teach assembly of each icon style.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says app icons are rights restricted and must not be altered or used for topics other than their names; stroke gradients remain stationary at 45°.

ingredient.name: App-icon families
ingredient.role: Differentiate products within the IBM identity.
ingredient.application: Use the documented stroke, fill or Plex construction. Preserve each style’s required elements and color behavior.
ingredient.scope: App icons represent named products or services, not generic subject matter or standalone brands.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
